description.en: Problematic pattern of alcohol use leading to impairment
description.hi: शराब के उपयोग की समस्याग्रस्त पैटर्न जिससे हानि होती है

mappingNote: ICD-11 Disorders due to use of alcohol is the 6C40 family (harmful use 6C40.0, dependence 6C40.2, intoxication 6C40.3, withdrawal 6C40.4, psychotic disorder 6C40.6); DSM Alcohol Use Disorder is a single graded diagnosis. Assess each system independently; 'use disorder' is not automatically equivalent to ICD dependence (index 14.1.2, operational rule on coding specificity).
